description: Ministry of Justice Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms - Guidelines made under Section 3. Conferring the Honour of Senior Instituting Attorney at Law Act, No. 26 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette contains guidelines made by the Minister of Justice under the Conferring the Honour of Senior Instructing Attorneys-at-Law Act, No. 26 of 2023. It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for legal professionals, specifically detailing the qualifications and procedures for conferring the honor of Senior Instructing Attorney-at-Law. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes or structural administration.
